diagnostic_only_samples.name: simpleStreams
diagnostic_only_samples.reason: compile blocked on CANN by device-only integer max overloads in simt_api/math_functions.h (host calls not viable); bridge simt_adaptor adds host-callable min/max templates. Pinned-memory and canMapHostMemory runtime semantics still unvalidated

diagnostic_only_samples.name: simpleMultiCopy
diagnostic_only_samples.reason: same host min/max compile gap as simpleStreams (7 call sites), addressed by the same bridge templates; mapped-host-memory / cudaHostGetDevicePointer surface remains unverified at runtime

diagnostic_only_samples.name: asyncAPI
diagnostic_only_samples.reason: upstream per-target CUDA_ARCHITECTURES sm_61..sm_120 made CMake emit a per-arch .cubin pipeline that puresimt cannot consume (ld.lld failed to open =asyncAPI/.../sm_120.cubin); harness now forces CUDA_ARCHITECTURES/CUBIN/FATBIN OFF for every sample target. Stream/event ordering remains unverified
